audit.adaptation_reason: Retained exact source split angles 20 and 32 degrees and side AD=9. Recomputed inconsistent ancillary AB, CF and angle CBD labels and explicitly marked them approximate.
audit.independent_solution: Angle DAB is 20+32=52 degrees. Adjacent parallelogram angles are supplementary, so ADC=128 degrees.
